    mc = next(c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 3 for r in range(h)))

        for c in range(w):
            if r == mr or c == mc:

                b = (b + 1) // 2

            if x % 2 == 0:
                v ^= 1
            out[r][c] = 4 if v else 0
